rule_text.name: 702.193a
rule_text.rule: Alpha is a static ability. “Alpha” means “You may have this permanent enter the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. If you do, it becomes alpha and can only attack alone.”

rule_text.name: 702.193b
rule_text.rule: If a permanent has multiple instances of alpha, each works separately.

rule_text.name: 702.193c
rule_text.rule: If an alpha permanent loses its +1/+1 counter, it's still alpha and can still only attack alone.

rule_text.name: 702.193d
rule_text.rule: Alpha is a designation that has no rules meaning other than to act as a marker that the alpha abilities and other spells and abilities can identify. Only permanents can be or become alpha. Once a permanent becomes alpha, it stays alpha until it leaves the battlefield. Alpha is neither an ability nor part of the permanent’s copiable values.

rule_text.name: 702.199a
rule_text.rule: Fabled appears on some instants and sorceries with a single target. It represents a static ability while the spell with fabled is on the stack and a spell ability. “Fabled (cost)” means “You may pay (cost) rather than pay this spell's mana cost as you cast this spell.” and “If this spell's fabled cost was paid, and this spell is a double-faced card with an Aura that can enchant that permanent or player as its back face, put this card onto the battlefield transformed and attached to it.”

rule_text.name: 702.199b
rule_text.rule: The fabled ability is linked to an ability printed on its front face that targets one or more objects that can be legally enchanted by its back face. If there are multiple possible targets, one is chosen as the spell with Fable resolves.

rule_text.name: 702.199c
rule_text.rule: If the targeted permanent or player is an illegal target for the Aura side of a card with fabled, such as a creature with protection from enchantments, the card with fabled will not enter the battlefield and instead be put directly into its owner's graveyard from the stack.

rule_text.name: 702.215a
rule_text.rule: Primal is a static ability that functions while the spell with primal is on the stack. “Primal (cost)” means “During your turn, you may cast this spell for (cost) rather than pay this spell's mana cost. If you do, casting this spell also counts as playing a land.”

rule_text.name: 702.215b
rule_text.rule: The spell with primal is still cast. It is not a special action, it only counts as playing a land when determining if a player can play a land this turn.

rule_text.name: 702.215c
rule_text.rule: A spell can be cast for its primal cost at any point during a player's turn, as long as the number of lands that player can play this turn is greater than the number of lands they have already played this turn, even if timing restrictions would normally prevent playing a land. This means a spell may be cast for its primal cost during its owner's upkeep or end step, but not during another player's turn, or during a turn where lands can't be played.
